title: 第23章 战马仟宇第24章 凝霜上阵
content_zh:
叶祈安也是收起腰间的酒壶，一跃而下挑跳到演舞台上。
此时朱家的弟子早已经安排好了人手，不断地在台下发起猛烈的嘲笑声音。
“叶平安，我要是你我就滚下台去了，这场考核根本看不到一点希望，你是不可能成功的。”
“没错，你以为你面对的是我们这些外院弟子吗？啊？”
“这小子恐怕还不知道他面对的对手是谁吧？哈哈哈！”
“这家伙面对的可是马仟宇啊，地元境后期，他拿什么跟人强榜前十打？”
叶祈安无动于衷，对于这些人的嘲讽，只有用行动狠狠打脸才能让他们闭嘴。
马仟宇此刻在台下无比热烈的欢呼声中脚尖轻轻一点跃向比试台上。
整个动作行云流水，犹如点水蜻蜓一般优雅。
这更加引得下方的一众女弟子尖叫不已。
“啊啊啊啊！！”
“马仟宇，马仟宇，我要成为你道侣，我要给你生一千多个猴子！”一个满脸都是麻子的肥胖女弟子尖叫着说道。
“去你的，就凭你这样的长相，别出来寒碜人了！”
虽然两人从颜值程度上比较比较互相上下。
但是奈不住人家背景实力更胜一筹啊，出来混。
就是要讲究实力背景。
叶祈安依旧是无动于衷，甚至开始闭目养神了起来。
马仟宇见到对方还是这副无所谓的样子，心中冷笑不已。
臭小子，别怪我无情了，就拿你的命来换取我修炼资源吧。
想起朱擎苍许诺给他的丰厚物资心头就一阵激动。

那就是淬炼塔。
为什么这么多外院弟子争破脑袋都想进入内院成为内门弟子？
就是因为成为内门弟子之后可以进入淬炼塔。
淬炼塔，
他低下头看向那道绝世白色倩影，眼神中充满着火热贪婪。
如此完美的惊天女子，怎么可能是这个毫无背景的草包拥有？
沈凝霜注意到台上马仟宇的侵略性目光，一股若隐若现的气息射向前者。
让他瞬间汗毛竖起！
叶祈安嘴角一抿，这家伙还真的是找死，连沈凝霜的主意都打，那就更加不能让你安然离开比武台了。
叶祈安气息轰然爆发，无比雄厚的元气席卷整个演武台。
让台下众多弟子神色一震。
从背后放下厚重古朴的剑匣，其重量瞬间就将花岗岩砸到出现一丝丝裂痕。
这一幕更是让马仟宇脸色逐渐升起一抹凝重。
这小子......
不对劲，地元境初期，这元气的雄厚程度...竟然不比我这个地元境后期差多少？
这怎么可能？！
叶祈安趁着对方愣神的瞬间，归尘剑出鞘，一个箭步冲出，身后出现片片残影，夹杂着磅礴的剑气斩向前者。
马仟宇瞳孔放大，这小子竟然搞偷袭，不过好歹也是强榜前十的强者。
很快就反应了过来，元气护体，爆发出强大的气息，手持长剑横挡在身前。
两者初步交锋，顷刻间就爆发出强烈的元气波动！

一阵阵的气浪将台下围观的外门弟子震飞数米。
两道身影迅速拉开距离。
浓烟散去，叶祈安古井无波的站着，看向前方那道狼狈身影，心中暗道。
强榜前十，果然是有点东西。
按照他现在的全力一击，就算不夹杂着剑意，普通的地元境后期不是我的对手。
content_en:
Ye Qian also put away the wine bottle around his waist and jumped down onto the stage.
At this time, the disciples of the Zhu family had already arranged their manpower and continued to make fierce mocking sounds from the audience.
"Ye Pingan, if I were you, I would get off the stage. There is no hope at all in this assessment. There is no way you can succeed."
"That's right. Do you think you are facing us disciples from the outer courtyard? Ah?"
"I'm afraid this kid doesn't know who he's facing yet, right? Hahaha!"
"This guy is facing Ma Qianyu. In the late Earth Yuan realm, how can he compete with someone in the top ten?"
Ye Qian was indifferent to these people's ridicule and could only shut them up by giving them a slap in the face.
At this moment, Ma Qianyu jumped onto the competition stage with a tap of his toes amidst the extremely warm cheers from the audience.
The whole movement is smooth and flowing, as graceful as a dragonfly touching water.
This caused the female disciples below to scream.
"Ahhhhhh!!"
"Ma Qianyu, Ma Qianyu, I want to be your Taoist companion, and I want to give birth to more than a thousand monkeys for you!" screamed a fat female disciple with a pockmarked face.
"Fuck you, just because of your looks, stop being such a shabby person!"
Although the two of them are relatively superior to each other in terms of appearance.
But I can't help but think that my background and strength are superior, so I come out to hang out.
It’s about paying attention to strength and background.
Ye Qian'an remained indifferent and even began to close his eyes to rest.
Ma Qianyu sneered in his heart when he saw that the other party still looked indifferent.
Brat, don't blame me for being ruthless, just trade your life for my cultivation resources.
Thinking of the generous supplies Zhu Qingcang promised him, he felt excited.
That is the tempering tower.
Why are so many outer court disciples fighting over each other to enter the inner court and become inner disciples?
It's because you can enter the tempering tower after becoming an inner disciple.
Tempering Tower,
He lowered his head and looked at the peerless white figure, his eyes full of fiery greed.
How could such a perfect and shocking woman be owned by this idiot with no background?
Shen Ningshuang noticed Ma Qianyu's aggressive gaze on the stage, and a vague aura shot toward the former.
It made his hair stand on end instantly!
Ye Qian'an pursed his lips. This guy is really looking for death. He even wants to kill Shen Ningshuang, so he won't be able to let you leave the competition stage safely.
Ye Qian'an's aura exploded, and the extremely strong energy swept through the entire martial arts stage.
The expressions of many disciples in the audience were shocked.
Putting down the heavy and simple sword box from behind, its weight instantly hit the granite until the slightest crack appeared.
This scene gradually made Ma Qianyu's face look solemn.
This kid...
Something's wrong, the strength of this energy at the early stage of the Earth Yuan Realm... is not much worse than mine at the late stage of the Earth Yuan Realm?
How is this possible? !
Ye Qian took advantage of the opponent's dazed moment, unsheathed the Guichen Sword, and rushed out with an arrow. Afterimages appeared behind him, mixed with the majestic sword energy, and slashed towards the former.
Ma Qianyu's pupils dilated. This kid actually carried out a sneak attack, but he was still one of the top ten strong men.
He quickly reacted, and the vitality guard burst out with a powerful aura, holding a long sword in front of him.
The two initially clashed, and strong energy fluctuations broke out in an instant!
Waves of air blasted the outer disciples who were watching from the audience several meters away.
The two figures quickly distanced themselves.
After the thick smoke dissipated, Ye Qi'an stood calmly in the ancient well, looking at the embarrassed figure in front of him, and thought to himself.
The top ten on the strong list is indeed something.
According to his current full-strength strike, even if it is not mixed with sword intent, the ordinary late Earth Yuan realm is no match for me.
